extraction.Name: T. C. Montgomery (primary affiant); J. D. Keller (secondary affiant)
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged for $1500.00, executed by W. E. Bridgman and Mary Bridgman, his wife, on August 10, 1923
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to T. C. Montgomery; consideration was $500.00 in currency and a Haynes automobile which W. E. Bridgman had agreed to purchase for $1000.00
extraction.NOTES: Land described as Northwest Quarter (NW¼) of Section 15, Township 102, Range 77, Tripp County, South Dakota. T. C. Montgomery states that before Mr. and Mrs. Bridgman signed the mortgage instrument, its nature was explained to them and he is firmly of the opinion that they understood it was a mortgage. Secondary affidavit by J. D. Keller sworn June 19, 1929, states that Winnie M. Keller is his wife and has no knowledge of transactions covering the described land, and that affiant purchased the land from Frank Kriehn and has no knowledge other than hearsay how the land was purchased and paid for by Kriehn. Primary affidavit sworn June 24, 1929 before Notary Public Henry C. Rurup. | TASK 5 NON-ALLOTTEE RECLASSIFICATION 2026-05-04: T. C. Montgomery (primary affiant) and J. D. Keller (secondary affiant) are neither allottees.  This record is reclassified as a non-allottee record (Document type = 'non_allottee_record'). The named individuals are not allottees; the document is retained in the corpus for its evidentiary value but does not represent a forced-fee allotment case.
